0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with Minnesota on the road. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota following Achilles surgery, and Keshad Johnson is out for Miami with a hamstring injury. Minnesota won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance to win.
